book.name: Hibru
book.title: Leta I Wa Weŋgiya Hibru Jisas Gha Ghambu Utuniye

content: Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye regha na regha ghatututhi i mena weŋgiya le valɨravowovowo, na i kaiwo Loi le gharɨgharɨ kaiwanji. Iye i mbana gharɨgharɨ lenji mwaewo na i vakatha vowo lenji tharɨ kaiwae.
Iye valɨkaiwae ghathanavu i udauda weŋgiya ranumounouno na thavala ma thɨ ghareghare iyaŋganiya thovuye, kaiwae amalaghɨniye tembe ele njavovova.
Iyake kaiwae mbaŋa i vowo tembe i vowova amalaghɨniye na gharɨgharɨ lenji tharɨ kaiwae.
Bigi reghava, ma valɨkaiwae lolo regha tembe ghamberegha i wovoreŋa na i tabo ravowovowo laghɨye. Loi ghamberegha i kula weya loloko iyako na i tabo ravowovowo laghɨye, ŋgoreiya va i kula weya Eron.
Tembe ŋgoreiyeva Krais. Mava i wovoreŋa ghamberegha na mbala i tabo na ravowovowo laghɨye. Ko iyemaeŋge Loi va i wovoreŋa e ghamba yakuko iyako. Loi kaerova i dagevaowe iŋa:

content.text: “Ghen naruŋgwa ghen, noroke ya tabo na Ramanɨna ghino.”

content: Na tembe inava e Buk Boboma regha tɨne i dagewe iŋa: “Ghen mbaŋake wolaghɨye ma ele ghambako ne u tabo ravowovowo ŋgoreiya Melkisedek iye va ravowovowo.”

Mbaŋa Jisas vamba ina e yambaneke le naŋgo e tɨne e ghareko laghɨye i kula voro weya Loi weiye le randa na valɨkaiwae i vamoru e mare. Loi va i loŋweya le naŋgoko, kaiwae i gharenja na i vareminja Loi.
Ko iyemaeŋge othembe va i naŋgo na ŋgoreiyako na othembe iye Loi Nariye, va i ghataŋa vɨrɨ na i mare, na e tɨne valɨkaiwae i ghareghareya Loi ghalɨŋae ghaghambu.
Kaiwae i vakatha ŋgoreiyako, i vaemunjoruŋa moli iye valɨkaiwae moli i giya vamoru memeghabananiye weŋgiya gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye iya thavala thɨ ghambu ghalɨŋae.
Na iyako e vwatae, Loi kaerova i vaemunjoruŋa na i tabo ravowovowo laghɨye ŋgoreiya Melkisedek iye va ravowovowo laghɨye.
Lemi loŋweghathɨ weya Krais ne hu ndeviyathu
Bigibigi lemoyo mbe inanjiwe nuwameiya wo utuŋa Krais kaiwae, iye ravowovowo laghɨye ŋgoreiya Melkisedek, ko iyemaeŋge i vuyowo ne wo vamanjamanjalaŋa weŋga kaiwae lemi gharegharena i vuyowo.

Vambe teuye valɨkaiwami hu tabo ravavaghare na hu vavaghare weŋgiya ghamune, iyemaeŋge lemi ghareghare amba ma i laghɨye, na renuwaŋa iviva moli Loi le utuutu kaiwae lolo regha wo i vaghareŋga. Ghemi ŋgoramiya ŋgama gunagunagha, amba thu vara i ndewoŋga, na amba ma valɨkaiwami hu ghana ghanɨŋga vurɨgheghe.
Thavala amba thɨ thuthu, thiye gamagai gunagunagha na amba ma e lenji ghareghare iyaŋganiya i rumwaru na iyaŋganiya i tharɨ.
Ko iyemaeŋge ghanɨŋga vurɨgheghe gharɨgharɨ matuwo kaiwanji, na thiye kaiwae tembe ghanjimberegha kaero thɨ vaghareŋgi valɨkaiwanji thɨ tuthiya thovuye na tharɨ.

footnotes.text: Eron iye iviva moli i tabo na ravowovowo laghɨye.
